'''Javroth Meers''' was a [[human]] member of the [[partisans]] led by resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]]. After being arrested for assault by the [[Milvayne Authority]], Meers knocked out an [[Unidentified Milvayne Authority officer|officer]], stole their [[Clothing|uniform]], and escaped. In [[1 BBY]], the human was among the partisan forces that [[Battle on Jedha|captured]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Jyn Erso]] and her allies in [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]].

The [[prisoner]]s were brought back to Gerrera's base in the [[Catacombs of Cadera]] on Jedha, where Meers escorted Erso to Gerrera. The [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star's]] [[Mk I Superlaser|superlaser]] then [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] Jedha City, and Meers was among the partisans that fled from the catacombs in order to try and avoid the blast wave it created.

==Biography==
[[File:JavrothEscort-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|Javroth Meers was one of Saw Gerrera's partisans.]]
The [[human]] Javroth Meers was a member of the resistance fighter [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[partisans]] during their [[Campaigns of Saw Gerrera's Partisans|campaigns]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Milvayne Authority]]—a [[law enforcement agency]]<ref name="Guide" /> based out of the [[planet]] [[Milvayne]]<ref name="Aphra">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 26|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 26]]</ref> in the [[Inner Rim Territories]]<ref name="GalaxyMap">[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]]</ref>—arrested Meers for assault, the human escaped custody by knocking out an [[Unidentified Milvayne Authority officer|officer]] and [[Thief|stealing]] their [[Clothing|uniform]].<ref name="Guide" />

By [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Meers was part of the partisan forces based with Gerrera in the [[Catacombs of Cadera]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. Following a partisan [[Battle on Jedha|ambush]] of [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] in [[Tythoni Square]] in [[Jedha City]], Meers and a group of other partisans led by the [[Tognath]] [[Benthic]] captured the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] agents [[Jyn Erso]] and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and the [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]] in a separate square, with Meers running up behind Andor and forcing him to the ground. After Erso informed them that she was the [[Erso family|daughter]] of Gerrera's old ally [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]], Benthic had bags placed over the [[prisoner]]s' heads so that they could be escorted to the catacombs. Meers pulled Andor from the ground once he had been bagged.<ref name="RO" />

[[File:JavrothRunning-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Javroth Meers fled from the Catacombs of Cadera after the Death Star destroyed Jedha City.]]
Once at the catacombs, Meers and another partisan escorted a bound Jyn through the structure to Gerrera, passing her off to Benthic once they reached the group's leader. As Gerrera and Jyn spoke, the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]] fired its [[Mk I Superlaser|superlaser]] at Jedha, [[Destruction of Jedha City|obliterating]] Jedha City and creating a shockwave heading toward the catacombs. The partisans inside began to flee, with Meers exiting the structure alongside the prisoner [[Bodhi Rook]] as Benthic ushered everyone toward what [[starship]]s they had.<ref name="RO" /> While Benthic and some other partisans did manage to escape the blast, many others [[Death|perished]].<ref name="SW39">[[Star Wars (2015) 39|''Star Wars'' (2015) 39]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Javroth Meers had tan skin and [[Color|black]] [[hair]].<ref name="RO" />

==Equipment==
As a badge of rebellion, Meers wore a stolen suit of Milvayne Authority [[armor]],<ref name="Guide" /> including a black and white [[helmet]], a padded, brown blast tunic, brown pants, black [[boot]]s, and a black [[utility belt]]. The tunic had webbing on the right shoulder and a black armor plate on both. The partisan also carried a [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="RO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Javroth Meers first appeared simultaneously in the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="RO" /> and its [[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] by [[Matt Forbeck]],<ref name="Junior">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> both of which were released on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books|author=[[James Floyd|Floyd, James]]|date=2016-12-14}}</ref> The character was then identified in the [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="Guide" /> within a section written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="DawnAuthor">{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}}</ref> The character's costume matches that of [[Tam Posla]], a character created for the film<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> who did not make it into the final cut.<ref name="RO" /> Posla was portrayed by<ref name="Allsopp Twitter 1">{{Twitter|MattAllsopp1|status/1389594695991533570|[[Matt Allsopp]]|date=2021-05-04|quote=ROGUE ONE - Had the pleasure to play Tam Posla (matt alsop backwards) for a weeks shoot. Never made it past the directors cut, but was a fun experience. However, I did make into the SW canon thanks to @PhilSzostak and @pablohidalgo Design by @glyn_dillon #May4th #RogueOne|archivedate=20210504165054}}</ref> concept artist [[Matt Allsopp]],<ref name="Art of Rogue">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> with costume designer [[Glyn Dillon]] letting Allsopp pick the design before tweaking it.<ref name="Allsopp Twitter 2">{{Twitter|MattAllsopp1|status/1389597952226861064|[[Matt Allsopp]]|date=2021-05-04|quote=Yes the incredible costume designer @glyn_dillon let me pick the design, and then we tweaked it a bit. I wanted to be a mysterious bounty hunter....but with my face hidden ;) He should have a re appearance in Mandalorina!|archivedate=20210504172644}} {{C|In response to: "What an awesome thing to be able to say 🤯 And one of my favorite background character designs 😎"}}</ref>
